Scope: Independent static review of RescueFeatures.inl against the saved retry/game-over evidence and shared TrainerContext/snapshot flow. No product changes, native invocation, build or live access by reviewer.
Verdict: No significant source or semantic defect identified in the reviewed version. This is a one-time edit of the selection counter plus read-only diagnostics, not an actor spawn or rescue override.
Confirmed: UseCountRva0x9AD660 is an unsigned16-bit exponent passed to powf at native0x1403FC7A0 and0x1403FCE10.
AppearCountRva0x9AD662 is a distinct unsigned16-bit statistic rendered as MICKEY APPEAR by0x140436F80. Native constructors0x140415670 and0x1404158C0 increment both words independently with a999 cap.
Slot176 validates an integer0..999 and writes exactly sizeof(uint16_t) at UseCountRva. It has no write to the neighboring appearance count, no actor call and no RNG access.

No Reset or Tick restoration is required for this deliberately one-time SaveData change; catalog and status text must continue to distinguish it from continuous effects.
RequiredPublicMeaning: Slot176 edits the roll's use counter, not the displayed MICKEY APPEAR statistic.

Count edits affect subsequent native decisions and may be retained by later game saves. They neither call a save routine nor alter an already selected GameOver rescue byte.
